payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear rationale for using ESE methods on user-generated text, highlighting the unique characteristics of such text that necessitate new benchmarks and evaluation metrics.

claims.text: User-generated text contains unique characteristics such as multifaceted entities, non-named entities, and vague concepts, which are not well-represented in existing benchmarks.
State-of-the-art ESE methods do not generalize well to user-generated text, often performing worse than simpler baselines, indicating the need for tailored evaluation metrics.
New benchmarks and evaluation metrics are necessary to effectively assess ESE methods on user-generated text due to its distinct characteristics.
